bible.text: So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you and help you; I will uphold you with my righteous right hand.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... it feels like You've gone quiet. I pray and nothing comes back.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It's been weeks now. Maybe longer. I don't even feel You anymore.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Silence isn't the same as absence. I haven't moved. I'm still here, even in the quiet.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Then why can't I feel it? Why does it feel like You stopped caring?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Feelings change. My presence doesn't depend on what you feel in this moment.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I just need something. Some sign You're actually listening.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I am listening. Even this question you're asking Me right now is proof you haven't stopped reaching for Me.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Maybe the silence isn't Me leaving. Maybe it's you learning to trust Me without needing to feel it.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Have you ever felt like God went quiet on you?
